strings.DriftDroid doesn't include any of Mario:
DriftDroid doesn't include any of Mario Kart Wii's code. You make it once on a Windows PC from your own disc:

1. Download DriftDroid Builder from the DriftDroid GitHub page.
2. Run it with your Mario Kart Wii disc image (PAL, .iso or .wbfs).
3. Copy the game pack .zip it makes to this phone and tap Import Game Pack.
